subject: executor: fix index out of range bug in hash join v2 (#55864)
summary: Fixes an off-by-one in hash join v2 nullmap concurrency gating so `isColumnNullThreadSafe` is never called with `columnIndex=31` (which would index `bitMaskInUint32[32]` and panic). Adds `TableMeta.isReadNullMapThreadSafe` plus a unit test to lock the boundary; later upstream history shows refactors/perf work but no follow-up bugfix indicating a remaining correctness issue.
